scope: 42 source-atlas entries, explicit selected mathematical targets; all new formal statuses unverified

contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Same predeclared property P(X_3=true), terminal re-entry allowed; no killed-kernel substitution.

contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Entire nine-start comparison B1; show lower bounds at all starts and attainment at a genuine start; no Exact-GR/PR promotion.

contracts.title: Unrestricted discounted-strategy verification
contracts.selected_scope: Bounded finite discounted stochastic games, arbitrary nonanticipating behavioral unilateral deviations, independent current opponent draw.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: MPECertificate.lean proves both-player Bellman, pure/mixed one-shot, support; typed E uses same world
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Fix observed information incl state/action histories; bounded rewards, beta=9/10, opponent baseline fixed, off-equilibrium starts, stage payoff availability (actions not on state path).

contracts.residual_scope: Clairvoyant/correlated-current-noise, risk-sensitive or strategic-world-changing deviations are excluded.

contracts.title: Strict opponent-locked MA2 feasibility and resolution
contracts.selected_scope: Finite autonomous strict anchors with full baseline-supported action/update agreement; separately standard-Borel all-time AE extension.

contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Anchor factorization through own S2 and permissible exogenous S0; common update cannot launder treated action; baseline-support agreement and reachable states exact.

contracts.residual_scope: Impossibility is scoped to these exact information and agreement premises; arbitrary measurable targets and weaker agreement are not universally resolved.

contracts.title: Geometric projected-prefix TV envelope
contracts.selected_scope: Finite spaces or measurable kernel common-mass and jointly measurable Radon-Nikodym lift profile; every fine row.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: ApproxPrefix.lean proves TV_T<=min(1,T*eta); EventTVCalculus covers triangle/product operations
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Defect bounds on every fine row incl counterfactual-reachable; typed q, matched starts; do not assume projected process is Markov.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Counterexample for non-Markov fine projection, eta=0/1, and vacuous horizons; prove common-mass measurability, not just analytic telescoping.
contracts.residual_scope: Arbitrary measurable spaces without the stated density/common-kernel bridge remain outside the proof.

contracts.title: Coupling W1 = Lipschitz-dual bridge
contracts.selected_scope: Finite metric probabilities; larger complete separable Borel space with finite first moments and explicit finite quantization proof.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: ContractiveOccupation.lean proves bounds for W1DualLE over bounded measurable 1-Lipschitz tests
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Add appropriate Polish/Radon/finite first-moment premises; handle unbounded metrics without silently requiring global sup-norm <=1.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Atomic finite examples; metric test classes; no false TV-to-W1 equivalence on unbounded metrics.
contracts.residual_scope: No equality for arbitrary sigma-algebras, no implicit first moments or supnorm-one replacement.

contracts.title: Invariant-law existence and uniqueness
contracts.selected_scope: Contraction preserving first-moment probabilities on a complete separable metric space; finite shortcut also specified.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: Existing contraction assumes invariant pi and pi-tilde and finite initial dual gap
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: No existence from invariance identity alone; decide whether both compared kernels contract or only baseline K does.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Identity/multiclass countermodels without hypotheses; chain convergence with independently established invariant law.
contracts.residual_scope: Only uniqueness within the declared class; perturbed invariant uniqueness needs its own sufficient condition.

contracts.title: Primitive or sufficient-condition contraction certificates
contracts.selected_scope: Direct bounded-Lipschitz row criterion giving the exact existing global dual predicate; finite Dobrushin and metric row-coupling certificates.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: ContractivePerturbation assumes IsW1Contraction; current A3 proof does not derive it
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: TV contraction does not imply unqualified W1 contraction on unbounded metrics; include diameter or direct metric bound.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Small finite kernels that do/not contract; check rho<1 as proved data, not relabeled input.
contracts.residual_scope: Does not need general KR for the direct dual result; unbounded metrics cannot silently use a TV coefficient.

contracts.title: Four genuine full-path ergodic factorizations
contracts.selected_scope: Explicit occupation-limit functional, four actual finite unique-class kernels; separate regenerative Polish profile with added moment conditions.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: occupationMargin_robust assumes all four psi(pathLaw_y)=F(h_#pi) identities on B1
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Correct start quantifiers, measurable Lipschitz descriptor and property functional; do not infer path values from invariant laws without ergodicity.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Mixed-class and nonergodic counterexample; four-process exhaustive hypotheses and direct original property equality.
contracts.residual_scope: Not factorization of every arbitrary preexisting property; regeneration/analytic prerequisites remain explicit.

contracts.title: Primitive metric kernel error to W1 defect
contracts.selected_scope: Weighted product metric and conditional stage couplings with declared action/world/update errors and Lipschitz sensitivities.
contracts.atlas_dependencies_as_supplied: A3-K01 for coupling form; A2 primitive laws
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: A2 derives primitive row event-TV; KantorovichTV.lean ALREADY proves bounded-diameter dual W1 <= D*TV and unbounded-metric noncontrol; A3 assumes row W1DualLE defects
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Changed P across compared models is model error, not a strategic intervention within each model; no universal TV to W1 on unbounded metrics.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Degenerate/large-diameter counterexamples, off-graph and unreachable baseline rows, stage-order mutation.
contracts.residual_scope: Coupling interpretation uses KR when needed; bounded-diameter TV wrapper reuses existing theorem without that dependency.

contracts.title: Augmented-state residence Bellman sufficiency
contracts.selected_scope: Finite fully observed known rational controlled process and literal retryable residence event.
contracts.existing_foundation_as_supplied: ResidenceEvent and ResidenceValue prove literal path event and optimum over deterministic full-history policies
contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: m transitions = m+1 observations; starting target counts; retries; entry vs completion deadline; no physical absorbing rewrite.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Hitting-vs-residence counterexample; time-zero, m=0, retrial, off-by-one, full-history equality and attainment.
contracts.residual_scope: No physical absorption or arbitrary nonlinear objective; entry and completion deadlines remain distinct.

contracts.title: Sharper sequential primitive product TV
contracts.selected_scope: Actual ordered primitive composition with measurable common kernels at each stage and uniform stage errors.

contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Measurable overlap at each stage under actual alpha-P-U sequence; uniform row bounds.
contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Examples saturating product; nonindependent stages; preserve off-graph rows.
contracts.residual_scope: The shared-mass lemmas are reused; no independence of error events is assumed.

contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: Do not silently replace true model margins by approximate reported outputs; control visit probability and initial law mismatch explicitly.

contracts.residual_scope: Empirical identification and arbitrary numerical uncertainty are not inferred from deterministic output-error ledgers.

contracts.title: Nonfinite/whole-path output transport
contracts.selected_scope: Summable weighted bounded finite-prefix scores; full path TV only with summable sequential error or a separately proved common-mass limit.

contracts.acceptance_and_falsifiers: Leakage counterexample; horizon dependence; missing property factorization.
contracts.residual_scope: Generic tail/survival functionals under fixed positive defect are not stable.

contracts.mandatory_hypotheses_as_supplied: No theorem can promote Exact GR merely from eta>0 and positive margin.
